title: Russian-Style Egg Bakes
description: A delicious Indian-inspired egg bake with spicy Russian flavors. Perfect for a quick and easy breakfast or brunch.
instructions: In a large skillet, sauté the diced bell peppers and minced garlic until tender.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, light cream, shredded cheddar cheese, chopped scallions, ground cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper.
Add the cooked bell pepper mixture to the egg mixture and stir to combine.
Pour the egg mixture into a greased 9x13-inch baking dish.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until the eggs are set and the top is golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
